nodes.text: In Mumbai, a six-month-old baby was diagnosed as the eighth case of human metapneumovirus (HMPV) in India,  The infant was hospitalized on January 1 due to severe cough, chest tightness, and a drop in oxygen levels to 84%. She was discharged after a five-day treatment. #news https://t.co/7aXm3OQvuA
